async def act(page):
    # Click the 'Toggle project select' button to open the project selection dropdown
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Toggle project select').click()
    # Wait for the dropdown to appear and select 'Primer / design'
    # Assuming the dropdown has options, use get_by_role('option') or similar
    # Since the exact role is not specified, I'll use get_by_text to select the project
    await page.get_by_text('Primer / design').click()
    # Wait for the page to update with issues from the selected project
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Click on the 'Clarify usage of flash alert' link to navigate to the issue page
    await page.get_by_role('link', name='Clarify usage of flash alert').click()
